name: Scheme of Internship for Post-Graduate/Research Students
benefit:
&gt; **Remuneration:**

  - **Internship Stipend:** A consolidated stipend of ₹10,000 (₹5,000 per month) is provided upon successful completion of the internship.  - **Direct Benefit Transfer:** The stipend is transferred directly to the intern’s bank account through electronic payment modes such as APB/AEPS.  - **Cashless Payment System:** No cash payment is made under the internship programm
_eligibility_text: - The applicant should be a citizen of India and; - He/She must be pursuing post-graduation/research from a recognized College/University/Research institute in Statistics/ Mathematical Statistics/Operational Research/Economics/Demography or any of the applied fields of Statistics. **Note:-** 1. The internship will be for a period of 2 months from the date of joining. 1. Each intern/student shall be required to submit report/paper (along with soft copy) at the end of the assignment, including inter-alia, his/her observations and suggestions, if any, regarding any possible improvement in the system.
